scope: Observational, teacher-forced physical-state reconstruction decoding only
reason_for_adjustment: Recorded videos do not establish single-variable counterfactuals; per-view clocks differ. Model and data access succeeded, enabling a separate observational decoding stage.
registration_basis: Before research activation capture and research-label-driven selection; pilot-only integrity inspection allowed.

cohort.amendment: Initial hash-threshold split yielded42/14/6. Fixed balanced cohort selected using metadata-only hash order before research labels.

sampling.eligibility: deterministic uniformly spaced live chunks after integrity filtering; any insufficiency blocks the cohort

capture.readout: spatial mean within each view tile, channel dimension2048
capture.target_alignment: each view own source frame2*t+1 for temporal codec pair t
capture.row_order: clip order, then view major, then latent time

probes.weights: equal weight per match, sum weights=1
probes.selection: minimize mean standardized30-target selection MSE per site; freeze global best site before confirmation
baselines: whole-match training-label shuffle with within-match row order preserved

reporting.uncertainty: bootstrap independent matches; views and frames are repeated observations
reporting.significance: confidence intervals descriptive; no family-wide physical or causal significance claim from all-site curves
reporting.causal_stage_gate: confirmed candidate plus controlled-pair audit and independent generated-video physical evaluator; observational probe accuracy alone cannot satisfy this
